title: Every Person Is One Of Two Things
hook: EVERY PERSON IS ONE OF TWO THINGS

steps.hook: Every person who enters your life is one of two things.
steps.curiosity: And you only find out which one... after they leave.
steps.build: Some come to bring you joy. Some come to break you open. The first ones, you'll miss. The second ones, you'll thank — later, when it stops hurting.
steps.payoff: So stop asking why they came. Ask what they left you with. Keep the blessing. Learn the lesson. And let the person go.
